svg.title: A small fetus: suspected on symphysis-fundus height or a risk factor and confirmed by ultrasound estimated fetal weight, intrauterine growth restriction is worked up for a maternal, fetal or placental cause, then gestational age (under 32, 32 to 37, 37 weeks or more) with the Doppler, fluid and non-stress test decides whether to deliver or monitor; each column gives clues, numbered investigations and the action in order

svg.text: A small fetus: is it GROWTH-RESTRICTED, and is it time to DELIVER?

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: suspect: symphysis-fundus height (SFH) more than 2–3 cm behind the weeks (after 20 weeks), or a risk factor

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: confirm ONLY by ultrasound: estimated fetal weight (EFW) < 10th percentile = small for gestational age (SGA) · < 3rd = real

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif
Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: intrauterine growth restriction (IUGR) is a PROCESS: it can sit above the 10th percentile

svg.text: history first, then tests for the cause it points to

svg.text: fetal well-being: umbilical artery (UA) Doppler · amniotic fluid volume · non-stress test (NST)
